title: Edge-Defect Spectral Methods for Higher-Order Rankings of Spanning Tree Counts
summary: In this paper, we study the higher-order ranking, by spanning-tree count, of graphs obtained from a complete graph by deleting a fixed number of edges. Using the edge-defect matrix determined by the deleted edges and the interaction number measuring the local overlap among them, we derive a stability inequality that quantitatively estimates the decrease in the number of spanning trees from the matching-deletion case.
